flow: Exposed Human (age a)->Infectious Human Symptomatic (age a)
Exposed Human (age a)->Infectious Human Asymptomatic (age a)
Infectious Human Symptomatic (age a)->Recovered Human (age a)
Infectious Human Asymptomatic (age a)->Infectious Human Symptomatic (age a)
Infectious Human Asymptomatic (age a)->Recovered Human (age a)
param: B Constant influx (recruitment) rate of susceptible human hosts (Table 1).
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts (Table 1; appears in unnormalized system (2.1)).
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes (Table 1).
k(a) Age-specific progression rate from exposed to infectious; latent period is k(a)^{-1} (Table 1).
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts (Table 1).
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts (Table 1).
βₕ(a) Age-specific transmission/contact rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible humans (Table 1).
βᵥ(a) Age-specific transmission rate from infectious humans to susceptible mosquitoes (Table 1).
ρ Probability an exposed host becomes symptomatic infectious (Iₕ) upon leaving Eₕ (Table 1).
σ Reinfection intensity factor: scales secondary infection of asymptomatic hosts and their contribution to mosquito infection (Table 1).
Nₕ(t) Total human population at time t (paper notation).
Nₕ* Asymptotic constant total human population used in normalized system (2.2) (paper notation).
λᵥ(t) Force of infection for mosquitoes (paper). Use in simulation to drive Sᵥ->Iᵥ if Sᵥ is modeled explicitly.
